tidal-colossus.description: A mountain of sea water and barnacled stone that rises from the deep. Every few rounds it drags the front line under with a crushing Undertow.

appearance.silhouette: Huge hunched giant with broad wave-crest shoulders and long arms hanging to the ground.
features: Body of dark blue water and barnacled stone
Shoulders that curl like breaking waves, topped with foam
Two glowing pale-cyan eye pits in a low, heavy brow
Long arms with fists like boulders, dripping
A lower body that fades into waves
appearance.pose: Looming forward, arms hanging, one fist rising slowly like a tide.
never: A smile or any friendly look

cinder-wyrm.description: A coiling wyrm of black stone and living magma that cooks the air around it. It turns the first reaction of every round back on the team with its Backdraft.

appearance.silhouette: Large wyrm coiled in a loose S with a wedge-shaped head and a tall frill of fins.
features: Body of cracked black stone with glowing orange seams
Wedge-shaped head with a mouth glowing yellow-white inside
Tall frill of jagged fins along the head and spine
Narrow, slit-pupil eyes in bright yellow
Smoke and a few embers drifting from its back
appearance.pose: Coiled and rearing, head lowered toward the viewer, jaw slightly open.

thornmother.description: A towering briar queen who mothers every seed and every thorn. Her Bramble Bind snares the creatures at both ends of each row.

appearance.silhouette: Tall, stooped tree-woman with a wide crown of branches and long vine arms reaching forward.
features: Trunk-like body of dark bark with a hollow face
Crown of bare branches with a few pink blooms
Long vine arms covered in thorns
Two glowing pale-green eyes in the hollow face
A few small seedling sprouts clinging to her skirt of roots
appearance.pose: Leaning forward with both vine arms stretched wide, as if to scoop up the whole party.

storm-sovereign.description: A crowned king of thunderclouds who looks down on everyone beneath him. His Lightning Rod always picks out the hardest hitter and strikes them first.

appearance.silhouette: Wide, floating cloud body with a jagged crown of lightning and a single raised bolt-spear.
features: Body of dark violet thundercloud with a lighter underside
A jagged crown made of yellow lightning bolts
Two sharp white eyes under a stern brow
One raised arm holding a long lightning rod
Cloud wisps instead of legs
appearance.pose: Hovering with his chin lifted and the lightning rod raised, looking down at the viewer.
